description: Huawei E171 (12d1:1506 «Mobile Connect» after the mode switch, firmware 21.157): NCM with AT over cdc-wdm, PCUI and modem ttys. ModemManager gets the control (cdc-wdm, AT^NDISDUP over NCM) and net ports only; the ttys stay with the engine for SMS storage (5 slots on the SIM, the parts of a long SMS fill it unseen) and the CNMI check (the owner's bench 2026-10-30: under ModemManager on every port the sent SMS went out, no reply ever showed)

hints.at_source: the owner's report 2026-10-30 (R3S, 25.12.6, ModemManager 1.24): if00 ff/02/61 ttyUSB0 (modem), if01 ff/02/76 huawei_cdc_ncm wwan0 + cdc-wdm0 (MM's primary AT), if02 ff/02/63 ttyUSB1 (diag), if03 ff/02/62 ttyUSB2 (PCUI), if04/05 storage; MM took cdc-wdm0, ttyUSB0 and ttyUSB2 as AT

radio.source: older Huawei: AT^SYSCFG for the mode (HANDOFF 136); AT^SYSCFGEX/HCSQ on newer firmware
